_doc: Reviewed, narrow allow-list for graduated records whose claim was corrected after their id was minted. An entry is honoured only if the id derives (cluster.pattern_id or sha256[:12]) from the entry's own original_claim/original_conditions, so a fabricated id cannot be added. Additions need code review. See check_memory_records.py.

entries.original_claim: When 'gh'/'git push' auth fails with 'Invalid username or token', check for a stale env var matching the CLI's exact lookup name (GITHUB_TOKEN for gh/git) before assuming the stored credential is broken -- 'gh auth status' with that var unset reveals whether a working keyring-stored token is being shadowed; scope the fix to 'env -u GITHUB_TOKEN <cmd>' per-command rather than editing the secrets file that defines it.
entries.reason: Claim text was corrected in place after the id was minted; id still derives from the original text recorded here. Memory stays append-only: the graduated record is untouched.
